VHM LIMITED

     Goschen Project
    Community Update

        ISSUE 11
    OCTOBER 2026


  PLANNING SCHEME AMENDMENT APPROVAL

VHM Limited has welcomed approval of the Planning Scheme Amendment (PSA) needed for key
infrastructure outside the Goschen Project Mining Licence area.
The approval covers important supporting works, including road intersection upgrades and the raw water
pipeline, and marks another step forward in preparing the Project for future development.
For the local community, this milestone provides greater certainty around the Project’s planning pathway
and the infrastructure required to support it.
The Goschen Project now has all material approvals to commence construction, mining, processing and
supply logistics.
VHM will continue progressing funding and Project planning, with a focus on keeping the community
informed as the Goschen Project moves through its next stages.

  ILUKA PARTNERSHIP

VHM Limited and Iluka Resources have announced a new long-term partnership connected to the
Goschen Rare Earths and Mineral Sands Project in Victoria.
The partnership is an important milestone for the Project and includes arrangements for Iluka to take
rare earths concentrate from Goschen, along with a funding package to support the Project’s
development pathway.
Under the agreement, Iluka will receive 100% of Goschen’s rare earths concentrate production for 18
years and will provide a cornerstone A$40 million convertible note funding package.
The partnership is another step towards progressing a Project that could support local jobs, regional
investment and Australia’s growing critical minerals industry.

 ✨ KEY HIGHLIGHTS FOR THE COMMUNITY INCLUDE:
      •  The agreement supports Australia’s critical minerals supply chain and the development of
          rare earths processing capability.
      •  Goschen’s rare earths concentrate is expected to supply Iluka’s Eneabba Rare Earths
          Refinery, helping build a more integrated Australian supply chain, support value add and
          jobs in Australia.
      •   Iluka’s investment provides early support for the Project as VHM continues planning,
          funding and development work.
      •  The partnership gives the Goschen Project a clearer pathway as VHM works towards
           future investment and Project decisions.

SUNI TAFE – MINING PATHWAYS PROGRAM

VHM is proud to have supported a new Mining Pathways program to be delivered by SuniTAFE, in
partnership with the Minerals Council of Australia and Resources Victoria. The Program will help local
people explore opportunities in the resources sector close to home.
For communities across the region, initiatives like this mean more local pathways into employment,
stronger support  for young people and jobseekers, and a workforce  better prepared  for future
opportunities.
Programs like this create real opportunities for regional communities — building local skills, strengthening
career pathways and supporting the workforce our sector needs for the future.
We’re pleased to play a part in initiatives that connect people, industry and community, and help ensure
the benefits of responsible mineral development are shared locally.





  GOSCHEN COMMUNITY REFERENCE GROUP

VHM Limited successfully established the Goschen Community Reference Group (GCRG), with its first
meeting held on 8 October in Kerang. The meeting marked a positive start for the group and provided an
important opportunity for open, two-way discussion between VHM and community representatives.
The GCRG was established to support ongoing communication and consultation between VHM Limited
and key stakeholders, including neighbours,  local community members, businesses, government
agencies and authorities, and local councils.
Meetings will continue to be held every quarter at various locations across the Gannawarra and Swan
Hill council areas. Each meeting will be overseen by an independent Chairperson- Jeni Coutts to help
ensure issues are openly captured, discussed and addressed.
The GCRG aims to increase awareness of the Project and its benefits to the region, while bringing a
valuable local perspective to community impacts, issues, interests and opportunities. It also provides a
constructive forum where community concerns can be better understood and, where possible, resolved
or mitigated. The minutes of the meeting will be publicly available through our website.
The  successful  first meeting  set a  strong  foundation  for  respectful engagement and ongoing
collaboration.
Through the GCRG, VHM Limited will:
    •  Provide timely, transparent updates on Project activities and progress
    •  Support genuine community input into planning and operational decisions
    •  Offer a constructive platform to raise questions, share feedback, and explore ideas

LOCAL COUNCIL COLLABORATION

Throughout the planning phase of the Goschen Project, VHM Ltd has maintained constant dialogue with
the Gannawarra Shire Council and Swan Hill Rural City Council to ensure they are updated on our
progress. We have Memorandums of Understand (MOU) with both councils that focus on items like road
management, housing and community investment.
VHM has a positive relationship with both councils which has assisted us in achieving significant
approvals like the Planning Scheme Amendment and Traffic Management Plan.
These relationships  will take on greater relevance for local business development as the Project
progresses. Healthy relationships foster healthy, strong communities and VHM is proud to support the
Ganawarra and Swan Hill councils in their community development.

  SWAN HILL MAJOR PROJECTS SHOWCASE


Early October, VHM Limited was pleased to
present  at  the  Swan   Hill  Major  Projects
Showcase,   an     initiative    of   Regional
Development Victoria that promotes the use of
the Industry Capability Network (ICN) in contract
and tender processes.
We shared an overview  of our Project and
discussed how local businesses can register
with ICN  to express  their  interest  in  future
contract and subcontract opportunities.
VHM is committed to supporting local capability
and helping businesses across the Swan  Hill
region connect  with  opportunities associated
with our Project. We encourage local suppliers
and contractors to register with ICN and keep
their business profiles up to date.
Thank you to Regional Development Victoria
and everyone who attended and contributed to
the Showcase.
